title: Girl Agent
description:
A sudden robot rebellion has thrown the world into chaos. Step into the role of skilled female agents, venture into dangerous zones and fight your way through intense gunfights to uncover the truth behind the riot.

Girl Agent is an action-packed top-down shooter with classic roguelike mechanics. Featuring fully randomized encounters and layouts, every run delivers a brand-new experience. Mix and match weapons, create your unique playstyle, and defeat hordes of enemies as well as powerful bosses.

Key Features• Procedurally Generated Runs: Enemy placements and supply shops change every time you play. No two adventures are the same.

• Dozens of Weapons & Gear: Choose from a wide selection of firearms and throwables. Combine different equipment to build your perfect loadout for any situation.

• Unlockable Playable Agents: Recruit and raise multiple unique female agents with distinct abilities and combat styles.

• Challenging Levels & Boss Fights: Explore diverse battlefields and take on tough bosses. The game offers smooth combat for both casual players and challenge seekers.
description_short: "Girl agent" is a girl theme shooting game. rogue. Each game is equipped with a random equipment supply store. You can combine freely and fight heartily.
